retellable.title: Delivered through the nursery drawer
retellable.summary: Minardi was born in 1955 at KP's Los Angeles Medical Center, where newborns were passed to mothers through a wall drawer. His mother retold the story every birthday, including sending him back through the drawer so she could rest.
retellable.quote: she would recollect the story of being delivered to her through the drawer by the nurses.
retellable.why: A narrator's own birth illustrates a famous KP care-design innovation.

retellable.title: Delivering babies in Mexican hamlets
retellable.summary: As a medical student in Guadalajara he helped deliver care in small villages with no health care, including home births. The families' gratitude, with no money exchanged, shaped his choice of a prepaid, mission-driven practice.
retellable.quote: we delivered babies in patients homes, um, use whatever utility there was, uh, at the time, in addition to what we brought with us
retellable.why: Shows how early service far from money shaped his values.

retellable.title: The dinner that dissolved the MSAs
retellable.summary: At a dinner with Mr. Cordova and Greg Adams, Jeff Weisz had Minardi explain why Southern California's Medical Service Areas were dysfunctional. Shortly afterward the MSAs were dissolved.
retellable.quote: I remember their faces that night because I couldn't believe what we were suggesting, but shortly thereafter we did that. We dissolved the MSAs.
retellable.why: A vivid moment when one argument changed regional structure.

retellable.title: Don't go on your own, Greg
retellable.summary: In a weekly call after the pandemic, KP CEO Greg Adams said the health plan might pursue national growth without Permanente. Minardi proposed doing it together, which led to the KP Medical Foundation.
retellable.quote: So Greg said, I'm going to go on my own. And I offered to him an opportunity that said, Greg, don't go on your own, but let's think about how we do this together
retellable.why: Origin story of the KP Medical Foundation, told by its co-creator.
